requirements: Claim this Linux job before executing it. Confirm the PR branch still resolves to the recorded full head and use a clean worktree.
Apply an uncommitted test overlay to solr/core/src/test/org/apache/solr/schema/DocValuesSkipListTest.java. Do not commit or push the overlay.
Enable the update log before initCore and use solrconfig.xml with the existing schema-docValuesSkipList.xml. The current basic config has no update log and would not exercise in-place updates.

Use the existing long_plain field as the no-skip control and longdv as the skip-indexed numeric target. Index existing documents, commit, apply atomic inc updates, and verify the control reaches 11 while the target is expected to reach 11.
Run only the named focused test. Capture the test output, the actual Lucene/Solr error text and fresh JUnit XML. Classify a compile or setup failure as incomplete, not as reproduction.

Reproduced means the control update succeeds and the target update fails in the Lucene DocValues-update guard because the field has a skip index. If the target update succeeds, verify that in-place eligibility was exercised before recording non-reproduced.
summary: Reproduce the atomic update failure for a skip-indexed numeric DocValues field on PR 5361.

test_overlay.method: Add testAtomicUpdateWithSkipIndexedDocValues. Index id=control,long_plain=10 and id=skip,longdv=10; commit. Apply atomic inc +1 to long_plain and assert success plus value 11. Then apply atomic inc +1 to longdv and assert success plus value 11. At the recorded PR head, the final update is expected to fail in Lucene updateDocValues because longdv carries a RANGE skip index. The test should fail at that assertion and expose the underlying error.
